text_content:
Google Fonts are automatically [https://fonts.google.com/knowledge/glossary/subsetting](https://fonts.google.com/knowledge/glossary/subsetting). Failing to specify any subsets while [/docs/app/api-reference/components/font#preload](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font#preload) is `` will result in a warning.

Font Optimization - Preloading
text_content:
If it's a [/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/pages](/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/pages), it is preloaded on the unique route for that page.
If it's a [/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/layouts-and-templates#layouts](/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/layouts-and-templates#layouts), it is preloaded on all the routes wrapped by the layout.
If it's the [/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/layouts-and-templates#root-layout-required](/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/layouts-and-templates#root-layout-required), it is preloaded on all routes.


When a font function is called on a page of your site, it is not globally available and preloaded on all routes. Rather, the font is only preloaded on the related route/s based on the type of file where it is used:
if it's a [/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/pages-and-layouts](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/pages-and-layouts), it is preloaded on the unique route for that page
if it's in the [/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-app](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-app), it is preloaded on all the routes of the site under ``

title: Font Optimization - Reusing fonts
text_content:
Every time you call the `` or Google font function, that font is hosted as one instance in your application. Therefore, if you load the same font function in multiple files, multiple instances of the same font are hosted. In this situation, it is recommended to do the following:
Call the font loader function in one shared file
Export it as a constant
Import the constant in each file where you would like to use this font
